JRT Group is a family-owned and operated throughout in Central Queensland. For over 20 years, JRT Group has shown a passion and a dedication for our work that has helped us to gain large numbers of satisfied clients. We offer everything from bulk earthworks to plant hire to our clients for a broad range of projects across the region. Our commitment to quality work and to each client we work with has made us one of the premier civil contracting companies in Central Queensland.

JRT Group is seeking qualified Mechanical Technicians to join their team. This role is responsible for the diagnosis, servicing, maintenance, and repair of light and/or heavy motor vehicles, requiring trade-level technical expertise and independent diagnostic capability.

Main Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Diagnose, assess, and troubleshoot mechanical and electronic vehicle issues using computerised diagnostic equipment
Dismantle, repair, and replace worn or defective mechanical parts, including but not limited to engines, transmissions, brakes, suspension, and steering systems, referencing service manuals and technical documentation as needed
Interpret manufacturer service manuals and specifications
Inspect vehicles and prepare service reports
Diagnose and resolve mechanical malfunctions, ensuring timely and effective repairs
Replace defective mechanical components and test vehicle performance
Conduct post-repair testing and adjustments to verify proper performance and compliance with safety standards
Accurately complete and maintain service records, inspection reports, and compliance documentation in accordance with regulatory requirements
Ensure compliance with WHS, environmental, and quality standards
Keep the workshop clean and organised while strictly adhering to health, safety, and environmental regulations
Support apprentices and junior mechanics

Required Experience and Qualifications
Trade qualified equivalent to Certificate III in Light or Heavy Vehicle Mechanical Technology
Minimum 2 years post-trade experience in the same field with ample knowledge in modern diagnostic systems and vehicle electronics
Strong mechanical knowledge on a wide variety of vehicle and equipment
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Able to meet productivity targets
Strong communication skills
Strong diagnostic abilities
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics
Valid Australian driver licence (or eligibility)
White Card (Construction Induction)

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

At the Law Society NT, our role extends beyond regulation. We exist to uphold confidence in the legal profession, protect the public interest, and ensure lawyers are supported by a fair, transparent and accountable regulatory framework.

We're now seeking an experienced legal professional to join our Executive Management Group as the Manager of Regulatory Services.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, this is a rare leadership opportunity to influence the integrity, accountability and future of the legal profession across the Northern Territory.

As a key member of the executive team, you will lead the Society's regulatory functions under the Legal Profession Act 2006 (NT), overseeing complaints and investigations, disciplinary matters, trust account regulation, admissions, licensing and professional standards.

This is a role for a senior lawyer who enjoys complex legal work, strategic leadership and making a genuine impact. Your key areas of responsbility will be to:

    Lead the Society's Regulatory Services Unit
    Manage complaints, investigations and disciplinary proceedings
    Act as solicitor on the record in Tribunal and Supreme Court matters
    Provide strategic legal and regulatory advice to Council and Committees
    Oversee trust account and licensing functions
    Support admissions and professional standards activities
    Contribute to policy development and regulatory reform initiatives
    Work closely with the CEO and Executive Management Group to achieve the Society's strategic objectives

To be successful, you will bring:

    Admission as a lawyer in an Australian jurisdiction
    Eligibility to hold an unrestricted practising certificate in the Northern Territory
    At least 7 years post-admission experience
    Strong litigation and advocacy experience
    Proven leadership and people management capability

Experience in professional regulation, investigations, complaints management, administrative law or disciplinary proceedings will be highly regarded.
Why join us?

This is an opportunity to step into a position of genuine influence where your decisions and leadership will contribute to public trust in the administration of the justice system and the ongoing development of the legal profession across the Territory.

If you're looking for a career-defining opportunity that combines legal expertise, leadership and public purpose, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, contact our Recruitment Business Partner, Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

result.description:
Sopho Pty Ltd as trustee for the Sopho Unit Trust trading as Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, operates a distinctive accommodation and hospitality destination in the heart of Kangaroo Valley, NSW, within the Southern Highlands and South Coast region and an easy two-hour drive from both Sydney and Canberra. The Retreat is centred on a historic 1901 Woolshed — relocated from Uri Park in outback NSW and lovingly restored in 1983 — which today houses The Woolshed Restaurant and provides a characterful setting for guests and private functions alike. The property is complemented by an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Jack Newton, and by Osteria La Vallata, an Italian-inspired fine-dining restaurant led by Chef Marco Salvestrin.

Welcoming overnight guests, golf and leisure visitors, function and event parties, and regional tourists, Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat delivers a premium accommodation and hospitality experience across its accommodation, dining, and recreation offerings. As a destination property in a popular regional tourism location, the Retreat depends on attentive, individualised guest care and consistent day-to-day operational oversight to maintain its standing and the high standard of guest experience for which it is known.

As part of its continued growth, Sopho Pty Ltd is seeking to appoint a skilled and experienced Accommodation and Hospitality Manager in a permanent full-time position. The role is responsible for the overall administration and day-to-day operation of Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, with a primary focus on accommodation services and the personalised guest experience across the property. The role offers a salary range of AUD $75,000 to AUD $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with the successful candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Job tasks and responsibilities
1.  Direct and oversee major accommodation - related operations such as reservations, reception, room service, and housekeeping activities across the property's 30 self-contained one-, two-, and three-bedroom cabins and villas, ensuring that turnaround, presentation, and guest check-in/check-out standards are consistently met.
2.  Plan and coordinate special functions, conferences and private events held in the Conference & Events Centre, liaising with clients on room setup, AV/presentation equipment and catering requirements.
3.  Coordinate closely with the Executive Chef to align front-of-house service delivery with kitchen output, executing and leading front-of-house service across Osteria La Vallata restaurant, in-room dining and event catering to deliver a seamless overall guest hospitality experience.
4.  Direct the Greenkeeper Superintendent and golf course maintenance team to ensure the 18-hole championship course and surrounding grounds are presented and maintained to the standard expected of guests and members.
5.  Supervise security arrangements and, through the Maintenance Manager, the upkeep of buildings, gardens, pools, tennis courts and other recreational facilities used by guests.
6.  Oversee the selection, training, rostering and supervision of accommodation, guest services, maintenance, golf course and other staff, and ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations across the site.
7.  Observe liquor licensing, food safety, health and other regulatory requirements relevant to the accommodation, restaurant, golf and function operations.
8.  Assess and review guest and customer satisfaction through feedback channels and online review platforms, and implement service improvements accordingly.
9.  Oversee purchasing and accounting activities related to accommodation, hospitality and course-maintenance operations, including supplier arrangements for housekeeping, maintenance, kitchen and guest amenities.
10.  Provide guests with local tourism information and coordinate golf, dining and activity bookings as part of the retreat experience, arranging tours or transport where required.
11.  Handle guest complaints and service escalations, negotiating with suppliers and other stakeholders to resolve issues, and conduct ongoing quality checks across accommodation, dining and event operations, initiating corrective action where standards are not met.
12.  Lead public relations and marketing initiatives to promote the Retreat and grow accommodation patronage
13.  Report on operational performance, staffing and guest service outcomes to the Operations Manager and General Manager, and contribute to forward operational planning, performance forecasting and risk management to support the retreat's ongoing service standards and growth.

How to join the team
To join our dedicated team for a rewarding career, please submit an online application. Only successful applicants will be contacted. Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or have the capacity to permanently work in Australia. Employment of a temporary visa holder may only occur if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.
